## The question

Affordability pressure has not stayed still. This project maps the movement of
the affordability frontier — the ring beyond which the median home costs less
than eight times median earnings — over fifteen years.

## Data and method

ONS house price to workplace-based earnings ratios at local authority level,
joined to boundary files and animated as a small-multiple sequence.

## Finding

The frontier moved outward by roughly 14 km between 2010 and 2022, then
stalled. The stall coincides with the rate rises of 2023 rather than with any
change in supply.

## Reproducing

All code is in the accompanying repository; the notebook runs end-to-end from
the raw ONS spreadsheet.
